verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a digital government tax service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of one. "Ask HMRC online" is listed only as a contact channel, with nothing describing AI task delegation, and the "agent" in the sign-up guidance is a human tax agent, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
